answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the plume of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the meadow of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
